data.name: Away
data.detailed_description:
Away — is a short game telling about the hero's death experience, performed in a gloomy black and white style.

Features:• Gloomy black and white graphic style.
• Pleasant sound environment.
• Full localization on English and Russian languages.
• Steam Achievements.
